articles.title: Why I’m Helping Build JK Sportsbook
articles.deck: Corey Becker on independent sports coverage, the people behind JKSPORTSBOOK, and making a place worth visiting.
articles.author: Corey Becker
articles.label: Founding Perspective
articles.body:
The world doesn’t need another sportsbook. It doesn’t need another self-proclaimed expert with a microphone, a few opinions, and a Monday-morning explanation for why he was right. It doesn’t need another personality promising to lock in a winner, or another platform telling you what to think before you’ve had the chance to think for yourself.

So why the hell am I helping build one?

Because I keep coming back to the way we talk about sports—and the way we bet on them.

Somewhere between living and dying with the Buffalo Bills, developing an unhealthy fascination with tennis, and spending years studying betting markets, I realized the most interesting part of sports isn’t the box score. It’s the psychology, the narratives, the people willing to challenge conventional wisdom, and the stories that never make the headlines.

With betting now woven into how so many of us follow sports, I find myself wondering what deserves our attention, what holds up, and what we might be missing. I want to cover sports independently, follow the questions that actually interest me, and figure out what I think along the way.

And then there’s the craziness that brought me together with Josh King and got this whole thing started.

Josh and I may be cut from the same cloth, but you wouldn’t always know it from our personalities. He’s outspoken, unpredictable, and never seems too worried about what people think. Between his unsolicited rants about Atlanta and the fact that he played on his high school’s girls' volleyball team before co-ed sports were a thing, there is always a lot to unpack with Josh.

“Heavy is the head that wears the crown,” he likes to say. And as his friend and business partner, I believe in him. I believe in his vision, and in the person behind it. That’s why I wanted to do this with him. Sometimes it takes a little crazy to see a possibility other people miss.

People connect with people. That’s what made me want to build something with Josh, and it’s what I want JK Sportsbook to be about: more than just a place to track action. We have a real opportunity to build something with personality, curiosity, and room to grow.

We’re bringing back the internet. JK Sportsbook isn’t an app you download and forget about. I want it to be a place you choose to visit—a destination for sports coverage, ideas, and stories, the way people used to visit the sites that shaped how we consumed sports in the first place.

We’re here to ask questions, follow the stories, and shine a light on what we find.

That’s why I’m helping build JK Sportsbook.
